## Problem and resulting behavior

Which issue or reproducible failure does this address? What changes for users?

## Scope and evidence

Game/platform, layout/version gates and source of evidence. Link related issues
or research. Retain contributor attribution and licenses. Distinguish hypotheses
from original-file observations; do not attach proprietary game assets.

## Validation

List exact commands, outcomes and tool versions. Separate synthetic tests,
original-file decoding, Blender structure, inspected renders, edited round trips
and in-game tests. Explicitly list checks not run and why.

## Remaining limits and delivery

Known unsupported cases, documentation changes, and whether packages were rebuilt.
Source-only PRs are welcome; state when builds still need maintainer packaging.

- [ ] I reviewed the diff and preserved unrelated work and component licenses.
- [ ] No game assets, secrets, local scenes or private manifests are included.
- [ ] Claimed checks were actually run; AI-generated claims have been verified.
